references.purpose: Creature centerpiece and translucent crystal wing diffraction reference
references.why_good: High-contrast warm ivory scales against cool cyan/violet crystal wings create immediate silhouette separation and focal depth.
references.transferable_principle: Separate creature body values from luminous wing/horn focal zones so masked foil shaders catch the wings and scales.
references.must_not_copy: Do not ship the reference image itself or clone its exact pose.
references.own_thing_plan: Generate original Prismhart and Solarius portraits via FLUX.2 Klein 4B with distinct silhouettes and custom foil masks.

references.purpose: Micro-hexagonal spectral scale diffraction texture reference
references.why_good: Demonstrates physical micro-facet rainbow dispersion rather than flat linear gradients.
references.transferable_principle: Use a procedural hexagonal micro-facet normal/diffraction pattern in the Prismatic Spectrum foil shader.
references.must_not_copy: Do not paste raw photographic insect/scale crops onto cards.
references.own_thing_plan: Synthesize real-time angle-reactive hex-grid diffraction in Canvas/WebGL and Godot shaders.

references.purpose: Living collector card frame hierarchy and luminous border filigree reference
references.why_good: Dark obsidian text box preserves 100% legibility while cyan/emerald seigaiha border and dragon veins glow.
references.transferable_principle: Isolate title and stat/ability plates on dark high-contrast obsidian; apply foil only to frame filigree and creature mask.
references.must_not_copy: Do not copy third-party TCG icons, copyright footers, or external card layouts.
references.own_thing_plan: Design a bespoke Prismatic Sanctuary card frame showing Origin, Instinct, Signature, Resonance Trigger, Serial Collector #, and Foil Tier.

references.purpose: Three-tier cosmetic foil taxonomy (Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, Relic Foil)
references.why_good: Establishes three distinct material personalities tied to creature fantasy rather than one generic holographic effect.
references.transferable_principle: Implement all three switchable foil shaders (Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, Relic Foil) with zero competitive stat impact.
references.must_not_copy: Do not ship the reference board crops.
references.own_thing_plan: Build real-time interactive shaders for all three foil classes in the card renderer.
